name: Rainforest Trust Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards (USD 250,000 and above)
summary: Larger grants to registered NGOs to create or expand protected or conserved areas, with no set maximum, reviewed at three fixed deadlines a year. A concept note is recommended four months before the deadline.

calls.label: Deadlines on March 1, July 1 and October 1 each year
calls.recurring: Deadlines on 1 March, 1 July and 1 October

status.quote: Rainforest Trust always welcomes new applications for protected and conserved area creation or expansion, with the following criteria and guidance designed to help streamline the process.

recurring.quote: Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards of $250,000 and above: March 1 • July 1 • October 1 of each calendar year

applicant_types.quote: All applicants must be legally registered, non-government organizations that are authorized to conduct work in the country of the proposed project.

geography.quote: Our primary focus is the tropics and subtropics but strong proposals from outside these areas that meet all other criteria will be considered.

access.quote: We only review applications submitted directly by eligible organizations, and we will work with you to refine your proposal if it aligns with our mission and priorities.

window.quote: Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards of $250,000 and above: March 1 • July 1 • October 1 of each calendar year; approved projects are typically funded about 6 months after each application deadline.

amount.quote: Application Deadlines for Protected or Conserved Area Creation Awards of $250,000 and above are: March 1 • July 1 • October 1
